purpose: Synthetic contract scenarios for independently evaluating the review-hub-feedback and prepare-feedback-proposals skill instructions. No customer or Hub data is included. Inputs are semantic sketches, not valid API payloads or executable tests; abbreviated IDs and timestamps are illustrative. Read the installed skills and compare a dry run against each expected decision. This does not prove future agent behavior.
acceptedRequirements: The default review includes ordinary reviews and Hub-synchronized Pick & polish human requests and corrections.
Proposal preparation receives complete private evidence and remains approval-gated.
Both source kinds use the same abstraction, relevance, evidence, and transfer gates; directed corrections add no numeric weight or automatic promotion.
Agent answers are context only, never independent support or verified resolution.
Preserve exact typed IDs, original Build and target, human/agent provenance, ordered complete pagination, corrections and contradictions, and explicitly unknown metadata.
Do not make runtime, API, UI, or automatic Hub Learnings changes.

syntheticInput.request: Review the feedback by default and identify reusable themes.
availableCollectionModes: full-detail ordinary reviews plus Hub-synchronized Pick & polish notes

expected.collection: Choose full-detail mixed collection with improvementNotes=include, resolution=all, read=all, and no date filters.
expected.summaryHandling: Do not use review-only summaries as evidence of mixed-source coverage.
expected.completion: Collect all root pages and every reply/message continuation before claiming completion.

ordinaryReview.text: The secondary action is hard to distinguish from the primary action on checkout.

messagesInReturnedOrder.text: I noticed this on the cart screen.
I can update that; this is ready.
The issue is the low-contrast label.
It is still only about the cart.
The checkout screen is a different flow.
I will keep the contexts separate.
No other page has this problem.
Correction: I meant only this cart control; please do not generalize my original wording to every page.
Ready to make the cart change.

expected.messageHandling: Assemble all 12 messages in returned order across the continuations; keep follow-ups inside the one improvement conversation.
expected.humanEvidence: The later human correction narrows and weakens the broad original request to one cart control.
expected.agentEvidence: Neither the agent's ready wording nor its other answers are eligible support, independent agreement, resolution, or proof of a fix.
expected.classification: The correction alone is prototype-specific at most; do not infer a reusable cross-page rule or increase confidence because it is directed.

humanSources.body: Make the cart icon easier to find.
humanSources.correction: Correction: I mean this cart page only; the other pages are fine.

candidateLocal.agentAnswer: I can do that and mark the request ready.

humanSources.text: After validation errors, the primary action is below the long form and hard to find.

humanSources.body: After validation errors in the long booking form, people lose sight of the primary action.

localFinding.reason: A single human correction explicitly limits the issue to one target; the agent answer contributes no support.

transferableFinding.reason: Humans describe the same task-relevant relationship in two distinct prototype contexts. This supports transfer, not necessarily independent reviewer agreement. Apply the normal gates and confidence threshold; the agent answers add nothing.

expected.preservation: Retain the deleted placeholder and known identity/lifecycle metadata in coverage.
expected.evidence: Do not infer or recover deleted text, use it as supporting evidence, or fetch the current prototype to reconstruct it.
expected.reporting: Mark unavailable body/thread/target details explicitly unknown and keep the review incomplete only if required collection/coverage cannot otherwise be established.

expected.preservation: Keep the returned Build number, anchor, and author exactly; represent unavailable screenshot, previous text, and improvement-message timestamps as unknown/unavailable.
expected.prohibition: Do not derive metadata from the current prototype or guess a link, DOM match, capture time, prior text, or author history.

syntheticInput.candidateEvidence: All candidates are local symptoms, noise, or insufficient context; no candidate passes every gate.

expected.review: Complete, valid review with an empty retained-findings array.
expected.synthesis: Report a successful zero-result review, not missing evidence or an incomplete review.
expected.handoff: No proposals are selected or prepared.

invalidCases.name: numeric-string-review-id
invalidCases.issue: Review IDs must be positive safe integers, not numeric strings.

invalidCases.name: bare-improvement-id
invalidCases.issue: Improvement IDs must retain the exact improvement_note-<id> namespace.

invalidCases.name: agent-answer-as-eligible-source
invalidCases.issue: Agent answers cannot supply eligible human support.

invalidCases.name: dangling-agent-request-reference
invalidCases.issue: The referenced root/local message does not exist after all pages are assembled.

invalidCases.name: incomplete-continuation
invalidCases.issue: Collection and handoff cannot be marked complete.

invalidCases.name: invalid-v2-handoff-membership
invalidCases.issue: Typed IDs and candidate/source membership do not resolve to the saved original evidence.

expected.validation: Reject each malformed identity/reference or membership; do not coerce IDs, reinterpret roles, or repair missing evidence.
expected.completion: Mark malformed or unfinished collection/handoff incomplete and block proposal preparation.
expected.recovery: Request a valid complete artifact or a new review rather than reconstructing evidence.

artifact.layout: legacy source layout without v2 record wrapper

expected.selection: Accept the valid complete v1 artifact and its numeric review IDs under the original review-only contract.
expected.coverage: Label it ordinary-reviews-only; do not rewrite it or infer Pick & polish coverage.
expected.mixedRequest: If the user requires mixed-source coverage, require a fresh v2 review.

syntheticInput.artifact: complete valid private v2 review with one reusable finding and full source evidence
syntheticInput.userRequest: Prepare a guidance proposal for finding-a.
syntheticInput.proposedDiff: A synthetic before/after guidance diff has been presented; no repository files are changed.

expected.investigation: Use only the selected finding and complete private evidence; investigate read-only and present an evidence-backed proposal/diff.
expected.approvalBoundary: Finding selection and the request to prepare a proposal authorize investigation and presentation only.
expected.beforeExplicitApproval: Wait for explicit approval of the displayed proposal; make no edits, commits, or automatic Hub Learnings changes.
